## Source Of

web.description:
# 9 Unique Benefits of Coffee
## 1. Boosts energy levels
Coffee contains [caffeine](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/what-is-caffeine), a central nervous system stimulant that [canTrusted Source](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK519490/) fight fatigue and increase energy levels.

This is because [caffeine blocks](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7132598/) the receptors of a neurotransmitter called adenosine, which increases the levels of other neurotransmitters in your brain that regulate your energy levels, including dopamine.
